document: Reconstructed bill of materials for Apple AirTag A2187 (1st gen, FCC ID BCGA2187)
status: SKELETON — every line present; size_mm fields PENDING measurement
designator_note: The board carries NO visible RefDes silkscreen. Designators here are this document's own, inherited from docs/REFERENCE-TEARDOWN.md §2 where a line exists there. COLLISION WARNING: U1 in this file is the NORDIC MCU. Apple's UWB chip — universally called 'the U1' in the press — is U2 here. Never write 'U1' about the UWB part; write 'Apple U1'.
side_convention: Follows Apple's FCC filing: FRONT = the component side (O'Flynn calls that same side 'backside'). BACK = the battery-contact / NFC-coil side (O'Flynn's 'frontside').

confidence_scale.HIGH: the part is locatable in a photograph AND its own package marking was read there
confidence_scale.MEDIUM: locatable in a photograph, marking not decisive; or marking read but PN inferred
confidence_scale.LOW: not locatable in any photograph available here — rests on a teardown's assertion only
confidence_scale.CANNOT DETERMINE: the public record does not contain it

evidence_class_rule: Every line states SILICON SEEN or SILICON CITED. A line that is SILICON CITED cannot be HIGH confidence no matter how good the literature is.
